title: Around the calendar
examplePrompt: When is the next town hall?
description: Find an upcoming published event, compare local times, or download its calendar entry.

title: The story desk
examplePrompt: What changed in the company this week?
description: Read or save a recent company story by topic or story ID.

title: Market atlas
examplePrompt: Which countries are furthest below bookings plan?
description: Locate covered markets by bookings volume and signed gap to phased plan.
negative: Explain the change between forecast cuts.

title: A place to meet
examplePrompt: Find a step-free room in London for six.
description: Find an eligible room for a local date and time and prepare a reservation for explicit review.
negative: Download the calendar entry for a published event.

title: The field guide
examplePrompt: Which travel policy applies in the UK?
description: Find published workplace resources by topic, title and locale, with their source and version.

title: Evidence to action
examplePrompt: Prepare a follow-up on German partner qualification.
description: Prepare and review an owned follow-up on an authorized commercial evidence cut. Recording requires an explicit confirmation.

title: Forecast bridge
examplePrompt: Why did Germany's quarter-end outlook move?
description: Explain signed changes between two forecast cuts for the same market and quarter.
negative: Compare booked-to-date performance with phased plan.

title: Bookings scorecard
examplePrompt: How are EMEA bookings tracking against plan?
description: Compare regional bookings against the phased plan and inspect weighted attainment.
negative: Explain why the forward forecast changed.

title: Lead conversion
examplePrompt: How many partner leads in Germany became opportunities this quarter?
description: Trace one acquisition cohort from source to opportunity. Compare converted counts and denominators by channel.
negative: Trace unresolved IT requests across service queues.

title: Your learning path
examplePrompt: What learning is due next?
description: Find a personal learning assignment, inspect its due date and record a reviewed section.
negative: Find the latest published travel policy.

title: Benefits preparation
examplePrompt: Help me prepare for my benefits review.
description: Prepare a benefits checklist and inspect deadlines without electing coverage.
negative: Send a private question to HR.

title: Pay statements
examplePrompt: Show my latest completed payslip.
description: Inspect a completed personal pay period. Values remain masked until revealed in the view.

title: Vesting timeline
examplePrompt: When is my next vest?
description: Inspect a personal award schedule, held units and future vesting milestones.
negative: Show company share prices or a payslip.

title: Time away ledger
examplePrompt: How much annual leave is available?
description: Explain available, booked and pending leave for a selected type and period.

title: Plan time away
examplePrompt: Prepare an annual leave request.
description: Prepare a leave date range, check working days and review before explicitly submitting.

title: Coverage planner
examplePrompt: Will the studio have coverage next week?
description: Inspect available capacity for an eligible team and week without exposing absence reasons.

title: Leave decisions
examplePrompt: Which leave requests need my decision?
description: Review an assigned colleague's leave request and confirm a decision after inspecting coverage.

title: Private HR support
examplePrompt: I need to ask HR a private benefits question.
description: Prepare a confidential question, review the recipient and explicitly create a session case.

title: Device passport
examplePrompt: Does my assigned laptop need attention?
description: Inspect an assigned device, its last check-in, update and refresh window.

title: Service health
examplePrompt: Is guest Wi-Fi down in Redmond?
description: Check the current incident and next update for a shared service at a workplace.
negative: Show the status of my individual support ticket.

title: Guided fixes
examplePrompt: How do I reconnect my second screen?
description: Find a reviewed device troubleshooting sequence and work through its steps.

title: Get technology help
examplePrompt: Report the display that flickers on my laptop.
description: Prepare a new break/fix ticket with a device, impact and optional guide. Review before submitting.
negative: Request new access or track an existing ticket.

title: Your conversations
examplePrompt: What is happening with IT-2048?
description: Inspect an existing personal ticket thread and its next owner.

title: Equipment desk
examplePrompt: I need a USB-C dock for my desk.
description: Prepare an equipment order with catalog cost, lead time and rationale; review before confirming.

title: Equipment decisions
examplePrompt: Review the display request assigned to me.
description: Inspect an assigned colleague's order, policy and cost; review and confirm a decision.
negative: Order a new item for myself.

title: Support trends
examplePrompt: Are we resolving tickets faster than they arrive?
description: Compare received and resolved support volumes across weeks for a scoped team.
negative: Trace the distribution of cases through service queues.

title: Support flow
examplePrompt: Which queue holds the most requests?
description: Trace the count of requests from intake through owning queues to outcomes.

title: App access
examplePrompt: Request contributor access for my work app.
description: Prepare a least-privilege app access request for resource-owner review; never grant access.

title: Explore the hub
examplePrompt: What can this hub help me do?
description: Browse and preview the 28 operational capabilities without taking action.
negative: Open a specific workspace or perform a known task.

title: Employee Hub
examplePrompt: Open the employee hub on TechWeb.
description: Open the requested authorized workspace landing, not a task, report or capabilities list.
negative: List the kinds of questions the hub can answer.
